title_draft: Does Happy Wheels on Steam Have Workshop Support?
quick_answer_draft: Steam Workshop support is not officially confirmed as of September 13, 2026. What is confirmed is a built-in Level Editor and interactive Level Browser with more than 5 million user-created levels and new daily submissions.
verified_facts: Official Steam page lists a Level Editor.
Official Steam page lists an interactive Level Browser.
Official Steam page says there are 5M+ user-created levels.
unknown_or_needs_recheck: Steam Workshop itself is not listed/confirmed on the official Steam page.
Do not infer Workshop from community speculation or third-party articles.
